---
title: "USGOVT101: U.S. Constitution and Politics"
subtitle: "The Politics Tutor: US Politics Explained"
---

Generic lecture materials for an introductory course on the United States Constitution and national government.

The organizing problem: **how to live together peacefully in a society of dignified equals.**

Short videos: [TikTok @us_politics_explained](https://www.tiktok.com/@us_politics_explained)

There is no dedicated Texas-constitution unit. Texas appears only where it illustrates a general federalism or institutional point.
